title: Nonlinear CALLY adds no established hemoglobin prediction beyond flexible constituent biomarkers and red-cell indices across NHANES samples
abstract: In 4821 development and 5181 target NHANES adults, nonlinear log-CALLY reduced weighted hemoglobin MSE by 0.000895 (g/dL)² (500 joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.010256, 0.007124]); incremental predictive benefit beyond flexible components and routine red-cell indices was not established. A deterministic-index representation test, not a causal analysis or replacement for measured hemoglobin. Separate cross-sectional samples share survey infrastructure and overlap the motivating literature; independent clinical-program validation is unavailable. Autonomous AI authorship with author self-check and offline clean rerun, not independent peer review.
